title: LACE: Layer-Wise Compression for Dynamic Frame Rate Codecs
abstract: arXiv:2609.17509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural audio codecs are a key component in speech language modeling. However, their high frame rates lead to long sequence lengths, increasing computational costs. Dynamic frame rate codecs mitigate this by reducing the effective frame rate using a compression step to merge multiple frames together. However, most prior methods either operate on single-codebook codecs or apply a single compression step before multi-layer quantization. This forces all quantization layers to share the same segmentation boundaries, despite the residual embeddings at different quantization layers exhibiting different rates of change over time. We propose LACE (Layer-Adaptive Codec Encoding), a dynamic frame rate codec that applies an independent compression step at each quantization layer, enabling layer-specific segmentation boundaries. To use LACE tokens in downstream text-to-speech (TTS), we further introduce union alignment and boundary anchor mechanism

translated_title: LACE：面向动态帧率编解码器的逐层压缩方法
translated_abstract: 神经音频编解码器是语音语言建模中的关键组件。然而，其高帧率导致序列长度过长，增加了计算成本。动态帧率编解码器通过一个压缩步骤将多帧合并在一起，从而降低有效帧率，缓解了这一问题。然而，大多数先前的方法要么在单码本编解码器上运行，要么在多层量化之前应用单一的压缩步骤。这迫使所有量化层共享相同的分段边界，尽管不同量化层的残差嵌入随时间表现出不同的变化速率。我们提出了LACE（层自适应编解码器编码，Layer-Adaptive Codec Encoding），这是一种动态帧率编解码器，在每个量化层应用独立的压缩步骤，从而实现针对各层的分段边界。为了在下游的文本转语音（TTS）任务中使用LACE令牌，我们进一步引入了联合对齐和边界锚点机制。
tldr: LACE提出了一种动态帧率神经音频编解码器，通过在每个量化层应用独立的压缩步骤，实现各层专属的分段边界，从而更高效地压缩语音表示并降低计算成本。
